information: #### THERE HAS BEEN A VENUE CHANGE FOR THIS COMPETITION More information on the new venue can he found [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WestNegrosCubeFest2025#58661-venue). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDk4MTMsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--00a5870a9a8d556fc7ff2c92c46d6963e9ae4652/image.png) The **Negros Speedcubers Organizing Committee** (NSOC) presents **West Negros Cube Fest 2025**. * All the necessary information can be found in the tabs above. * If you are interested in participating, the full registration details can be found [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WestNegrosCubeFest2025#58010-payment-and-registration). * Please be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/) before participating. * Please take note that the schedule given is not fixed and may run ahead or behind depending on the competition flow that day.
